auszuege.business: MetaX Integrated Circuits (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. researches, develops, and sells graphics processing unit chips and computing platforms. The company offers integrated training and push GPU, intelligent computing inference GPU, and graphics rendering GPU; GPU servers; GPU accelerators cards; and supernodes, as well as operates GPU workstation. The company serves digital computing, infrastructure, finance, healthcare, energy, education and research, transportation, and digital entertainment sectors. The company was founded in 2020 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
